messages:
alex: heads-up — circuit-breaker 688 tripped and rerouted ~20% traffic to fallback in us-west. seeing latency + cost spike :rotating_light:
sam: link to the dashboard? :eyes:
alex: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/routing?view=egress_us-west — 95p latency doubled since 2970012000, error rates flat
priya: is that manual or auto? who touched the breaker?
deploy-bot: policy-trigger: breaker-688 -> triggered by policy 'latency-surge-v2' at 2970012000 (rule: 95p>800ms for 3m)
alex: looks auto — policy threshold got more aggressive after yesterday's rollout. plan to unwind carefully.
ira: oncall here. we should avoid a full immediate flip. propose a staged unwind: drain -> 10% primary -> monitor 15m -> 50% -> full. also need TTL guard and alert suppression to avoid oscillation.
sam: agree. prefer `redwoodctl` for audit trail.
alex: ok. rough exec plan:
1) set breaker 688 state=drain for us-west
2) adjust route weights: primary=10%, fallback=90% -> primary=10% (start canary)
3) monitor `routing.latency.95p` and `routing.error_rate` for 15m
4) if green, ramp 50% -> 100%

command I'll run (audit-friendly):
```
redwoodctl breakers update --id 688 --state drain --region us-west --reason "auto-misfire after rollout"
redwoodctl routes weight set --route-id primary-egress --region us-west --weight 10
```

priya: add a sticky cookie TTL so we don't bounce the same session-server frequently. and add a 5min cooldown on the policy that triggered it.
alex: good call on TTL. i'll set session-ttl=300s on the routing rule and bump policy cooldown to 10m.
ops-bot: audit-log: breaker 688 state change requested by alex at 2970012420
alex: performing step 1 now.
ops-bot: action: `redwoodctl breakers update --id 688 --state drain --region us-west` executed by alex at 2970012500 (audit id: a-9f3b)
ops-bot: route-weight update in progress: primary-egress -> 10% (us-west) at 2970012520
priya: seeing 95p latency start to drop on grafana, good sign.
ira: enabling a temporary alert backoff for routing.latency and adding an oscillation detector rule.
sam: i'm watching logs — no surge in 5xxs, cost trending down a bit.
alex: ramping to 50% after 12m of stable metrics.
ops-bot: route-weight update: primary-egress -> 50% (us-west) at 2970012700
priya: 95p latency almost back to normal, error rate steady.
ira: locking the canary for 20m and creating a follow-up ticket to revert policy changes that caused sensitivity.
alex: created INC-2026-45 in incidents, added playbook and the `redwoodctl` commands we used.
sam: nice. quick retrospective: policy thresholds need versioning so rollouts don't change live thresholds without a canary.
priya: agreed — add a config flag `policy-rollout-canary=true` default false to safety-gates.
alex: will open a PR for that. good catch.
ops-bot: audit-log: full restore to primary=100% executed by alex at 2970012880 (audit id: a-9f3c)
alex: closing this thread — breaker unwound, primary restored, incident INC-2026-45 created with notes. will follow up on policy tuning PR. thx team :thumbsup:
